commits.subject: docs: resolve vulnerability policy review findings
commits.body:
Let a scoped Administrator exception clear an Unknown finding, which
otherwise blocks like High until trusted classification. Define the
refusal outcome and per-attempt classification lifetime, fix v1 scan age
at 86,400 seconds, allow fresh pre-admission scan attempts, limit v1 to
vulnerability findings, accept one direct recorded approval for several
records, bind approvedAt to the approval event and define revocation
timing. Fix v1 at the revision completing Story 5.2.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
(cherry picked from commit edc16e3cb41818cb7cda60a130f1df3b86a9d92f)

commits.subject: fix(test): check owner state and job on attach retries
commits.body:
Run context and owner-state checks before retry lineage, decide owner state
again under the attachment lock, require a local owner for the failure-retained
exception, treat corrupt attachment metadata as unverifiable, record expiry as
the end time of an expired hold, reject mixed attach options, and keep CI owners
out of hold-deferred cleanup listings.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.message:

Run context and owner-state checks before retry lineage, decide owner state
again under the attachment lock, require a local owner for the failure-retained
exception, treat corrupt attachment metadata as unverifiable, record expiry as

out of hold-deferred cleanup listings.

listing of attached runs and hold deadlines, published holds in results
and descriptors, and owner success-cleanup that waits for live holds.
